reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file and pattern as PRODUCT_112 (0f8f8094d28.c), dead store on 'n' (int n = *cache) inside init_node_lock_keys(). CONFIG_SLOB=true and CONFIG_SLAB=true is a contradictory/impossible configuration (Linux only allows one memory allocator). In the simplified vbdb file they are treated as independent booleans. When SLOB=true, kmalloc_caches is undeclared (inside #ifndef SLOB), so accessing cache is undefined. n is never used after being assigned — simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug (OutOfBoundsRead on kmalloc_caches when SLOB=true) is the relevant issue, but the dead store on n is a secondary simplification artifact.
